stem.text: A boy on a bicycle starts from rest and rolls down a hill inclined at $30^{\circ}$ to the horizontal.
The boy and bicycle have a combined mass of $25\,\text{kg}$.
There is a frictional force of $30\,\text{N}$, which is independent of the velocity of the bicycle.
What is the kinetic energy of the boy and the bicycle after rolling $20\,\text{m}$ down the slope?
